title: SmartGadget
tagline: A wholesale gadget shop with an open admin dashboard
description: A complete wholesale electronics storefront for the Bangladeshi market — catalogue, tiered wholesale pricing, product pages, cart, checkout and order tracking — plus the admin dashboard the owner runs it from. The dashboard opens with no sign-in so a prospect can look straight through it, and every figure in it is fictional.
highlights: Volume pricing that steps down as quantity rises, shown per product
Admin dashboard with no password — nothing sits behind it to protect
The full measurement stack wired to its own container, never the live one
Mobile-first — built for phones before desktop

access.label: Admin dashboard
access.note: No sign-in. This demo has no database and no API: every order, customer and metric is read from a fixture file in the repository, so an open dashboard shows exactly what reading the source would.
